title: Winey Pillowy Peruvian Lomo Ceviche
description: Peruvian-inspired dish featuring halal-friendly ground cardamom and a smoky kick, perfect for when you're feeling under the weather.

ingredients.name: Halal-friendly firm white fish (such as halibut or snapper)
Aji amarillo peppers
ingredients.notes: depending on desired level of heat

instructions: Rinse the fish under cold water and pat it dry with a paper towel.
Cut the fish into small pieces and place them in a non-reactive bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar, lime juice, aji amarillo peppers, salt, and black pepper.
Add the vegetable oil to the vinegar mixture and whisk until combined.
Pour the marinade over the fish and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours.
Just before serving, stir in the chopped cilantro and potato starch (if using).
